raw.rationale: Baricitinib is a reversible JAK1/2 inhibitor with weak antiproliferative activity in most adherent solid-tumor lines at 2.5 µM; selective killing would require lineage-specific JAK/STAT dependence, which is uncommon outside JAK2-mutant hematologic cancers not represented here. Published PRISM-type screens show little to no lineage-selective viability for JAK inhibitors in solid tumor panels, so probabilities remain near baseline.
